text:
```yaml
name: Mark and close stale issues and PRs
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this issue should remain open, please leave a comment or add a label.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this PR should remain open, please leave a comment or add a label.
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue was closed because it has been stale for the specified period and no further activity occurred.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request was closed because it has been stale for the specified period and no further activity occurred.
          days-before-stale: 60
          days-before-issue-stale: 60
          days-before-pr-stale: 60
          days-before-close: 7
          days-before-issue-close: 7
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          close-issue-label: 'closed'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'bug,enhancement,documentation,help wanted'
          close-issue-reason: 'not_planned'
```
